description: Trigger evals: does the skill fire when it should, and stay silent on near-misses against adjacent adding-ep-support, check-model-feasibility, and autoconfig workflows. 9 should-trigger + 9 should-not. Negatives are deliberately tricky keyword-overlap cases, not obvious non-matches. Consume with an externally installed skill-creator description optimizer.
